**Valmont depot handover**

Established: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts, 410 daily departures, 530 winter peak, 1.8% cancellations, 1100 parts lines. Certified June 2023; renewal due June 2028. Ops lead: Halvard Onstad. Night supervisor: Teodora Blaskovic. Parts supplier contact: Ingrid Solheim.

Failed/fixed: Feb 2025 brake-line failure grounded 9 vehicles 4 days; cause unestablished. Sept 2024 fuel-card cloning lost €4200; noticed late.

Decided: parts contract renegotiated Nov 2025. Training curriculum revised April 2026.

Planned: second charging bay Q3; electrification study approved, unfunded.

Open: night shift understaffed; old ticketing terminal on 3 routes; winter-peak capacity unmodelled; May 2026 double-published roster left 2 shifts uncovered.

Rules: brake check every 6000 km; fuel card second approval >€200; part >€500 needs two quotations; route change 7 days' notice; incident report within 24 hours; roster single named publisher; driver training 11 days.
